title: Prepare REL-v0.7.0 candidate through current-main pre-tag

scope.authorization_source: Owner decisions recorded in the 2026-07-28 conversation: promote release traceability as REL-003, freeze four-item scope, declare non-breaking exact-v0.6.0 upgrade compatibility, disclose limitations, and proceed through current-main pre-tag.
out_of_scope: creating, moving, deleting, or pushing Git tags
creating a GitHub Release or publishing package artifacts
creating or modifying GitHub Issues or Projects
historical archive migration, legacy identifier retirement, STD-001, DEVWF-001, INIT-001, or OBS-001

steps: Register REL-003 and reconcile the exact four-item v0.7.0 backlog set.
Instantiate all six release-publication templates without copying a previous release instance.
Build and validate deterministic candidate packages, exact v0.6.0 upgrade, authored release documents, and the candidate lifecycle contract.
Obtain independent ai-context-auditor candidate verification and close the workflow evidence.
Commit, push, open a ready pull request, pass required checks, and merge through the pull-request-only main policy.
Run the sanctioned current-main pre-tag command and stop before any tag or publication action.
